title: Hatsune Miku — The Top Karuta-Playing Idol?〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: That practice Karuta match we did was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
I agree.
So much so that I'd like to do it every year.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Also, Miku, you were unbelievable!
Based on your speed alone, it's like you became a pro after playing just once last year!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe... Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
But you did really well today, Len!
You got so many cards despite it being your first time playing.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Very true. You seem to have a knack for figuring out how to play these sorts of games, Len.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
You think so?
To be fair, I'm still nowhere near Miku's level, so I'd like to try harder next time.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Rin!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hi, Miku...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Is everything okay, Rin?
You've had this cloud hanging over your head all day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-M-M-Miku...!
I'm tired of losing!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Eep!
Wh-What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She lost to Len at Karuta today...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, is that why you've been feeling this way...? You really shouldn't beat yourself up like this since Len really does seem to have a talent for this.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: He and KAITO even started playing chess for fun, but before we knew it, he'd racked up a huge winning streak...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
B-But...!
I played last time...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wait, Miku, I know what to do!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Please teach me how to play Karuta, Master!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: M-Master...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You can ask all you want, but I really wouldn't know where to start...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Okay, in that case... Why are you able to get cards so fast? Can you explain that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Why I can get cards so fast...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well, the poems for “Hyakunin Isshu” are all organized in a certain manner. An upper half to go along with a lower half.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Right!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So in theory, knowing which half goes with which should help increase the speed in which you get cards.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's why I went ahead and memorized them all!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: A-All of them...?!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you're an idol... You really memorized every Hyakunin Isshu poem...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? I mean, I thought it'd be more fun and spectacular if I did everything I could to prepare for it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
M-Miku...!
Your aura's overwhelming...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But that explains everything...
No wonder I couldn't beat you!
I'll try memorizing them too!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Great!
Once you've done that, we can start experimenting with how to get cards even faster.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Though a swift stream is divided by a boulder...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Think you know the other half, Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hold on... Wait...
“A swift stream”... That's...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No...!
I tried memorizing them, but I can't remember which is which...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I see...
I don't blame you. The language they use is very archaic and cryptic...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're really good at memorizing lyrics, right, Rin? Why don't you try applying that method to Hyakunin Isshu?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? But... I like memorizing the lyrics to songs because I want to sing them. This seems a bit different...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: No, each poem is actually a song!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They're traditional Japanese songs, but they're still songs nonetheless... Wouldn't it help to think of them like that?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example, that last poem... “Though a swift stream is divided by a boulder, it rushes on, though divided, until it is at last reunited.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: By Emperor Sutoku himself!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Sutoku...?
Hehe. That actually sounds like a good artist name!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: See? We can also try thinking about what this poem is talking about since they use such archaic language.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's easier to learn lyrics when you know the meaning behind them, no?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It may take a while to figure everything out, but we can just take it one step at a time!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay!
Let's start with the part about a “swift stream”...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: On the surface, it appears to be talking about a stream literally crashing against a boulder...
One week later

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Turn and pose...
Then...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Hm? Rin? Miku?
What's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, let's play Karuta!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Right now...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Please, Len!
I practiced a lot and want to finally get a win!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Alright, I understand.
If that's how it is, then challenge accepted.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yay! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Good luck, Rin...!)
